### Dataset Metadata & Overview

* **Generator and Version**: The data is an OpenStreetMap export generated by the Overpass API (version 0.7.62.4) utilizing OSM API version 0.6.


* **Geographical Scope**: The dataset contains the boundary of the Autonomous Province of Trento (Trentino, Italy), with bounding box from minimum coordinates `45.6728669, 10.4522048` to maximum coordinates `46.5330375, 11.9628023`. The administrative centre is located at `46.0664228, 11.1257601` (Trento).


* **Data Structure**: The export is a JSON object with the keys `version`, `generator`, `osm3s` and `elements`. `elements` contains a single `relation` (ID 45756) with `admin_level` = 6 (province).


* **Total Counts & Members**: The relation has 337 `members`: 170 `way` members with role `outer` (the perimeter, about 21,000 coordinate points in total), 166 `relation` members with role `subarea` (the municipalities) and 1 `node` member with role `admin_centre`.


* **Link with municipalities**: The 166 `subarea` members reference the OSM ids of the 166 municipality relations in `municipalities.json`, so they give the "municipality is part of province" relationship.



### Mandatory Fields & Explanation

* **`type`**: At the root level of the element it is "relation". Within the `members` array it is "way", "node" or "relation".


* **`id`**: A unique numerical identifier for the relation itself (45756).


* **`bounds`**: The `minlat`, `minlon`, `maxlat`, and `maxlon` coordinates forming a bounding box around the entire geometry.


* **`members`**: The array listing the constituent parts of the relation. Each member has:
  * **`ref`**: the id of the referenced element. For ways in this export it is an internal geometric reference like "_fullGeom27988593"; for nodes and relations it is the OSM id.
  * **`role`**: the function of the member: `outer` (boundary line), `subarea` (municipality) or `admin_centre` (Trento).
  * **`geometry`**: only for `way` members, an array of `lat`/`lon` points giving the shape of the boundary line.
  * **`lat`** / **`lon`**: only for `node` members, as flat keys.


* **`tags`**: The metadata of the province. The main ones are:
  * `admin_level` = "6", `boundary` = "administrative", `type` = "boundary"
  * `name` = "Provincia di Trento", `official_name` = "Provincia Autonoma di Trento", `short_name` = "TN", `alt_name` = "Trentino"
  * `ISO3166-2` = "IT-TN", `ref:ISTAT` = "022" (prefix of the ISTAT codes of its municipalities), `ref:nuts` = "ITH2;ITH20" (also `ref:nuts:2` = "ITH2", `ref:nuts:3` = "ITH20")
  * `wikidata` = "Q16289", `wikipedia` = "it:Provincia autonoma di Trento"



### Optional Fields & Explanation

* **Multilingual names**: `name:ca`, `name:cim`, `name:de`, `name:es`, `name:fr`, `name:fur`, `name:hu`, `name:it`, `name:ko`, `name:mhn`, `name:ru`, `name:sk` and the `official_name:cim`, `official_name:de`, `official_name:lld`, `official_name:mhn` variants.
